acceptance: A variable that the allowlist does not name never reaches the gate child, proven by a test through gaterun.Run
The host integration tests of gaterun still pass at shadow and enforce
fix: Build the child env from an allowlist (PATH, HOME, LANG, TMPDIR and the Go variables the entry needs), reuse the ipcenv allowlist pattern, and pin it with a test that a parent variable such as GH_TOKEN never reaches the child.
